headline: Behind Iran's "everything is going great": not even pensions paid for months; government owes farmers 200 trillion
summary: Iranian state media report record wheat output of 14.1 million tonnes and 69% year-on-year growth in bank loans. Meanwhile, the government owes farmers about 200 trillion rials, and retirees face months of unpaid pensions.
why: Iran's economy faces high inflation and sanctions pressure, so payment arrears to farmers and pensioners signal fiscal strain that affects domestic demand and food supply.
